Another girl (Kasuga Ayumu) with long brown hair in a white shirt and blue skirt appears shy, and a girl (Kasuga Ayumu) with short dark blue hair in a yellow shirt and white shorts looks cheerful. A boy (Kasuga Ayumu) with dark hair in a green shirt and white shorts has a mischievous expression. A girl (Kasuga Ayumu) with short purple hair in a dark purple shirt looks shy.
